issues.detail: The Greek 'δε ηξιου' (de hexiou) means 'not to be counted' or 'should not be counted.' The Vietnamese 'cho là đáng kể' (considered significant/worthy) is a mistranslation of the negative sense and the specific concept of counting someone as part of the group.

The Greek uses a double negative construction (δε... μη...) to express 'should not be counted.' The Vietnamese fails to capture the 'not' in 'hexiou', turning a prohibition into a statement of significance.
